Townhall.name: Townhall
Townhall.description: The heart of the city, where new villagers begin their lives.

Housing.name: Housing
Housing.promise: Villagers live here and pay taxes
Housing.description: A snug home for villagers, who pay their rent in gold.

Farm.name: Farm
Farm.description: Its farmhands reap the fields nearby and fill the granary.

FarmLands.name: crop plots
FarmLands.promise: A crop plot you can tap for food
FarmLands.description: A field of golden wheat, ripe for the reaping.

Sawmill.name: Sawmill
Sawmill.promise: Workers fell the forest around it
Sawmill.description: Woodcutters fell the forest nearby and stack the timber.

Quarry.name: Quarry
Quarry.promise: Workers cut stone from nearby rock
Quarry.description: Its workers cut stone and iron from the hills nearby.

Docks.name: Docks
Docks.description: Fishing boats set out from here and come home full.

Sanctum.name: Sanctum
Sanctum.promise: Holds more Mana while you are away
Sanctum.description: Stores Mana within its enchanted walls.

Tavern.name: Tavern
Tavern.promise: Heroes gather here, and learn faster
Tavern.description: Where heroes come for a hot meal and a hard job. The banner hangs by the fire.

Barracks.name: Barracks
Barracks.promise: Trains soldiers and raises the army cap

SpearHall.name: Spear Hall
SpearHall.promise: Trains Lancers, who stop a charge
SpearHall.description: Trains lancers, who hold the line against a charge.

ShootingGrounds.name: Shooting Grounds
ShootingGrounds.promise: Trains Archers, all attack and no armour
ShootingGrounds.description: Trains archers, deadly at range but fragile up close.

Stables.name: Stables
Stables.description: Trains riders, swift and fierce but costly to keep.

Infirmary.name: Infirmary
Infirmary.description: Heals wounded soldiers so they can fight again.

Carpenter.name: Carpenter
Carpenter.description: Rough logs go in, and smooth planks come out.

MasonsYard.name: Mason's Yard
MasonsYard.description: Masons shape raw stone into fine building blocks.

Smelter.name: Smelter
Smelter.description: Ore goes into the furnace and comes out as iron.

RuneCarver.name: Rune Carver
RuneCarver.promise: Villagers pour Mana into cut stone
RuneCarver.description: Carvers bind magic into stone, rune by rune.

Garden.name: Garden
Garden.description: Bright flowerbeds that make the whole street smile.

Well.name: Well
Well.description: Fresh water, and a spot where neighbours stop to chat.

Orchard.name: Orchard
Orchard.description: Rows of fruit trees that sweeten the air of the town.

Statue.name: Statue
Statue.promise: A crowned figure in pale stone
Statue.description: A proud monument the townsfolk love to show off.

Plaza.name: Plaza
Plaza.promise: A paved square for market day
Plaza.description: A paved square where the town comes alive on market day.

Shrine.name: Shrine
Shrine.promise: A temple of runes that holds a relic
Shrine.description: An old temple of runes. Repaired, it holds one city relic, whose power reaches every building in its aura.

WarCamp.name: War Camp
WarCamp.promise: Sends more armies out at once
WarCamp.description: Where armies muster for the world beyond. Each level sends one more out at once.

Watchtower.name: Watchtower
Watchtower.promise: Sees past the province, to the world
Watchtower.description: The old tower on the northern hills. Repaired, its lens looks past the mountains — to the world and the kingdoms in it.
